visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Real-life video begins with a young woman wearing a grey off-the-shoulder top and blue jeans, standing in a brightly lit modern office coffee corner. She speaks directly to the camera with exaggerated hand gestures and a cheerful facial expression. The background features white subway tile walls and office shelving. (2) Close-up shots focus on the Nespresso Momento 120 machine, a sleek metallic coffee maker with a circular digital interface. Multi-colored coffee capsule boxes are displayed on a white tiered rack next to the machine. A hand is shown interacting with the touch screen to select a beverage. (3) The woman is shown in various office scenarios, including sitting at a communal wooden table with colleagues and typing on a laptop while sipping a latte. The environment is clean and professional, with bright naturalistic lighting. Background characters include other office workers blurred in the distance. (4) Detailed shots of the coffee extraction process show milk frothing followed by rich espresso pouring into clear glassware. The woman demonstrates placing used capsules into a branded white recycling bag. She concludes by pointing toward the bottom of the screen with a wide smile.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female Mandarin narration begins immediately alongside an upbeat electronic pop BGM. The speaker maintains a bright, professional tone with rapid articulation. The music features driving synth melodies and a steady 4/4 electronic drum beat. (2) A mechanical click is heard as a coffee capsule is handled, followed by the narration continuing with high intensity. The BGM provides a consistent rhythmic background without overpowering the vocals. The spectral balance is bright and crisp. (3) A digital chime sound triggers as a finger touches the machine interface. This is followed by a low-frequency whirring sound of the pump and the bubbling texture of milk frothing. The narrator continues describing the technical specifications enthusiastically. (4) A soft plastic rustling sound occurs as a recycling bag is presented. The narration shifts to environmental sustainability topics while maintaining a high arousal level. The BGM tempo remains stable, supporting the fast-paced information delivery. (5) A whoosh transition effect signals a visual shift as the speaker moves through different office settings. The vocal clarity is excellent, suggesting professional studio recording conditions. The audio maintains a high signal-to-noise ratio throughout the segment. (6) A final digital impact sound punctuates the call to action as the narration wraps up. The background music begins a rhythmic fade-out, leaving a clean vocal tail as the video concludes. The overall mix is highly polished.
